mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate above 5.1% signals labor market stress, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate weaker corporate earnings and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not exceed 5.1% in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate combined with robust GDP growth indicates accommodative monetary policy and expanded corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined signal does not predict returns significantly better than individual proxies (p > 0.05 in t-test) or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 215 signals rising inflation expectations, prompting investors to anticipate higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in such episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 215 in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: An upward surge in the INDPRO supply index above 110 indicates tight supply conditions, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in such episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO does not exceed 110 in the observed period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the UNRATE below 5.0% within a late-cycle expansion regime signals labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% in late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such episodes are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not fall below 5.0% in the observed period within the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST demand indicator above 1100 and GDPC1 GDP growth above 12000 signals robust demand conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined signal does not predict returns significantly better than individual proxies (p > 0.05 in t-test) or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the FEDFUNDS rate above 3.0% within a monetary tightening cycle signals aggressive policy tightening, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.0% in monetary tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such episodes are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 3.0% in the observed period within the regime.
